SELECT
    m.EmployeeKey                                          AS ManagerKey,
    concat(m.FirstName, ' ', m.LastName)                  AS ManagerName,
    count(e.EmployeeKey)                                   AS DirectReportCount,
    avg(
        dateDiff('year',
                 toDate(e.HireDate),
                 toDate('2009-12-31'))
    )                                                      AS AvgTenureYears
FROM retail.DimEmployee e
JOIN retail.DimEmployee m
    ON toInt32(e.ParentEmployeeKey) = m.EmployeeKey
WHERE e.ParentEmployeeKey IS NOT NULL
  AND e.HireDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    m.EmployeeKey,
    m.FirstName,
    m.LastName
ORDER BY DirectReportCount DESC
